title: Filing of Complaint by Central Authority

content.scenario: The Central Authority discovers a company engaging in unfair trade practices, causing harm to numerous consumers. The Central Authority decides to file a complaint against the company.
content.outcome: The complaint is filed by the Central Authority, and the court takes cognizance of the offence under sections 88 and 89 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: How can the Central Authority file a complaint?
What are the consequences of unfair trade practices?
Can the court take action without a complaint from the Central Authority?
